answer: Best mechanism: randomized grading-panel rotation each epoch. Every identity vault stakes a deposit, and each epoch a plume of verifiable randomness selects a small grading panel to grade all work, membership secret until selection. An attacker cannot predict who judges, so colluding with fake identities never pays; rigging one epoch needs most staked vaults, and any grader caught colluding forfeits its deposit - the pigment of trust making sybils worthless. Attacker cost: that majority stake, forfeited on detection.
